info.name: Hacker's Haven YouTube Theme
info.description:
Step into the world of elite coders and digital explorers with the Hacker's Haven YouTube Theme. This design brings a sharp, tech-savvy look to your YouTube experience, channeling the classic "hacker" aesthetic with dark backgrounds and neon green accents. Perfect for anyone who wants to infuse their online viewing with an edgy, high-tech vibe.

Features:

Background: Deep black (#0d0d0d) to set the stage for your hacking adventures.

Text: Vibrant neon green (#00ff00) for a striking, matrix-like contrast.

Video Player: Pure black (#000000) to keep the focus on your content.

Sidebar and Comments: Subtle dark grey (#1a1a1a) for a cohesive and immersive experience.

Links: Neon green (#00ff00) to match the text, making navigation intuitive and visually appealing.

Perfect for tech enthusiasts, coders, and anyone who appreciates a sleek, futuristic look. Transform your YouTube browsing into a cyberpunk paradise with the Hacker's Haven theme!
